Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Multiscale modeling of hydrogen diffusion in iron: Effect of applied stresses and dislocations

Composition_Info.Note: Study on interstitial hydrogen diffusion in pure BCC-Fe lattice.

Process_Text.original: A multiscale approach combining DFT-calculated interaction energies, object kinetic Monte Carlo (OkMC), and a phase-field (PF) model for dislocations.
Process_Text.simplified: 结合DFT计算的相互作用能、对象动力学蒙特卡洛(OkMC)和位错相场(PF)模型的多尺度模拟方法。

Microstructure_Text.original: Iron lattice containing dislocations creating complex stress fields.
Microstructure_Text.simplified: 包含位错产生的复杂应力场的铁晶格。

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: Hydrogen at edge dislocation core in BCC-Fe
Properties_Info.Note: Binding energy between hydrogen and dislocation core calculated via DFT/Multiscale.

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: With and without dislocation effects at variable temperatures
Properties_Info.Note: The model predicts significant reduction in H diffusivity near dislocation cores due to trapping effects.
